title: Add a response header
summary: Flask: Add a response header. Inspect the header with curl -i.
introduction: make_response lets you add metadata before sending a reply. GET /note has Cache-Control: no-store.
learningObjectives: Add a response header with Flask

blocks.text: In a practice folder create a virtual environment and install Flask with python -m pip install flask. Save one example as app.py and run python app.py. Use http://127.0.0.1:8000.

blocks.title: Add a response header

blocks.text: make_response builds a response first, allowing the cache header to be added before return.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Headers describe the response; changing one does not change its body.
